principles: Direct technician observations are confirmed findings, not discoveries.
Headline describes the system condition rather than raw observation count.
Possible underlying causes exclude direct restatements.
A fan explicitly observed Normal is not listed as a fan-failure possibility.
Obvious physical faults are corrected before unrelated measurements are requested.
